description: Inline copy of the shared preset the design describes (github>OWNER/renovate-config#v1): config:best-practices + security:openssf-scorecard, nix manager for flake.lock, minimumReleaseAge 7 days, automerge minor/patch after 14 days, pinned action digests.
Kept self-contained so a project has no cross-repo dependency; policy changes arrive through `copier update` instead of a preset tag.
